name: More Female Clothing - A Boss Feminization Port (For your PMC)
teaser: More Female Clothing for your PMC? Sure, why not - Just remember to install W.A.A.C as well!
description_html:
You need to install W.A.A.C or your game will crash when using the tops!: WTT - W.A.A.C. (Women’s Advanced Assault Corps)

Do you want more female clothing? Do you wish the Boss Feminization Mod was updated to 3.9 AND you could use them as clothing? Well now, thanks to my awful hodgepodge coding skills, now you can!

Tops and bottoms can be bought from Ragman for free. Heads you can either select on chargen or use the Head Changer to switch existing characters over. W.A.A.C also has female voices if you don’t want your PMCs to sound like they smoke more than Mechanic.

Credit to the WTT team for letting me use their clothing codebase, and for making the sick W.A.A.C mod, and to AT for the OG Boss Feminization mod, and publishing it under the MIT license, so I was able to make this.

IF YOU DO NOT INSTALL W.A.A.C YOU WILL HAVE NO HANDS AND YOUR GAME WILL CRASH. I REFERENCE THEIR HAND MODELS SINCE THE O.G. MOD DOESN’T HAVE FIRST-PERSON HANDS. IF YOU INSTALLED W.A.A.C LIKE YOU’RE SUPPOSED TO, GO COMMENT “YAY I HAVE HANDS” IN THE COMMENTS.
